outcome: Composite neonatal morbidity (bronchopulmonary dysplasia, intraventricular hemorrhage, periventricular leukomalacia, necrotizing enterocolitis, late-onset sepsis, and retinopathy of prematurity)
cohort: 242 very low birth weight (VLBW) infants delivered between 24 to 31 weeks of gestation
finding: Compared with vaginal delivery, cesarean delivery was associated with a lower composite neonatal morbidity in very low birth weight infants.
